personagens.descricao: young adult man about 20, the channel's recurring hero, short messy chunky dark-brown hair, big round expressive eyes, thick eyebrows, light olive skin, wearing a bright royal-blue knitted wool tunic with sweater texture and rolled sleeves, brown rope belt, beige linen trousers, brown leather sandals
adult man about 45, leader, short neat black beard, wise determined eyes, wearing a long deep-purple robe with gold trim and a white cloth turban, leather sandals

two comic adult men rivals standing side by side: one tall and skinny with a pointy black goatee, dark red striped robe and red head scarf; the other short and round with a curly brown beard, olive-green robe and brown head scarf; both with smug mocking grins
small chunky low-poly orange fox, big round cartoon eyes, white chest, fluffy white-tipped tail, mischievous expression

cenarios.descricao: ancient Jerusalem around 445 BC on a rocky hill: the city wall broken into long piles of pale limestone rubble, a big wooden city gate burned and charred black, small flat-roofed stone houses behind, olive trees, dusty paths, warm orange sunset light
dry rocky hillside just outside the ruined walls of ancient Jerusalem, low piles of fallen limestone blocks, a few olive trees, the broken city wall in the background, warm late-afternoon light

the stone city wall of ancient Jerusalem under reconstruction in daylight: wooden pole scaffolds tied with rope, half-built limestone wall sections, families working in front of their own flat-roofed houses, baskets of stones, mortar buckets, dust floating in sunbeams, many small busy workers in the background, bright cyan sky with cubic clouds
enemy camp at night on a hill outside the walls: dark tents, a small campfire, spears leaning on rocks, deep navy sky with a big glowing moon, the city wall with tiny torches far in the background

top walkway of the half-rebuilt stone city wall at night, burning torches on poles, deep navy sky with a big glowing white moon, guards with spears and round shields, workers still laying stones behind them
a big wooden table holding a detailed low-poly 3D miniature model of ancient Jerusalem with its ring-shaped city wall, tiny houses and tiny workers, warm lamp light, dark cozy room
the complete tall limestone city wall of ancient Jerusalem with new wooden gates, colorful festive cloth banners, cheerful crowd celebrating on top, golden-hour sunlight, bright sky with cubic clouds

modern archaeological excavation site in the City of David, Jerusalem, on a sunny day: ancient stone wall foundations and a large stone tower ruin, grid strings and measuring tapes, plastic buckets, trowels, brushes, pottery shards on a tray, modern buildings and hills in the background

cenas.camera: low angle from behind and slightly beside the Hero, wide-angle lens, slow push-in
cenas.acao: the Hero arrives at the top of the hill carrying a travel bag and freezes, jaw dropping, as he sees the broken wall and burned gate
cenas.audio: wind, distant crows, a bag dropping on the dirt

cenas.camera: dramatic close-up from below of the Hero's hands holding a charred black wooden plank from the burned gate, his worried face behind it
cenas.acao: the Hero lifts the burned plank and ash crumbles off it, he looks up at the huge ruined wall, wide worried eyes

cenas.camera: low angle medium shot of the two Rivals, wide-angle lens
cenas.acao: the two Rivals point toward the wall and burst out laughing, holding their bellies

cenas.camera: ground-level side shot of a small low pile of stacked stones, the Fox in the foreground
cenas.acao: the little Fox hops onto a tiny pile of stacked stones and the stones wobble and tumble down comically, the Fox looks surprised
cenas.audio: stones clattering and tumbling, a small cartoon boing

cenas.camera: medium shot, the Hero centered, camera slowly orbiting
cenas.acao: the Hero sits alone on a block of rubble, shoulders down, sighing, chin in his hands, discouraged

cenas.camera: heroic low angle on Nehemiah, the Hero seen from behind in the foreground
cenas.acao: Nehemiah confidently unrolls a long papyrus plan of the wall in front of the Hero, the Hero's eyes light up

cenas.camera: wide establishing shot along the wall, slow sideways tracking, many families each working on the wall section right in front of their own house
cenas.acao: families pass stones hand to hand and stack them, the Hero places a stone in front of a small house, children carry little baskets
cenas.audio: busy construction, stones clacking, hammers tapping, cheerful voices without words

cenas.camera: close medium shot lit by the campfire from below, slightly tilted angle
cenas.acao: the two Rivals huddle over the campfire whispering a sneaky plan, rubbing their hands with evil grins
cenas.audio: crackling fire, crickets, sneaky whispers without words

cenas.camera: close-up of Nehemiah's face lit by a torch, slow push-in
cenas.acao: Nehemiah raises one eyebrow and gives a clever confident half-smile, lifting one finger as if he has a smart idea
cenas.audio: torch fire crackling, a soft suspense swell

cenas.camera: wide shot along the wall walkway: a row of guards with spears and round shields in front, workers laying stones behind them
cenas.acao: guards stand alert scanning the dark while the workers behind them keep building; the Hero is among the workers lifting a stone
cenas.audio: stones being set, armor clinking, night wind

cenas.camera: close-up of the Hero from the chest up, a big stone block on his shoulder held by one hand and a short sword held up in the other hand
cenas.acao: the Hero balances the stone on his shoulder with one hand and raises a short sword with the other hand, determined look, then winks

cenas.camera: low angle on a watchtower: a bearded adult man in a brown tunic blows a long curved ram's horn (shofar), then quick view of workers running along the wall
cenas.acao: the man blows the long curved ram's horn with puffed cheeks; workers along the wall turn and run toward the sound
cenas.audio: a loud shofar ram's horn blast, running footsteps

cenas.camera: slow top-down three-quarter view over the miniature 3D model of the walled city
cenas.acao: a glowing golden sound-wave ring pulses outward from one point on the miniature wall, and dozens of tiny figures along the wall all run toward that glowing point like an alarm
cenas.audio: soft alarm chime pulses, tiny footsteps

cenas.camera: low angle hero shot of the completed wall, the Hero and Nehemiah on top
cenas.acao: the Hero and Nehemiah raise their arms in victory on top of the finished wall as the crowd cheers and banners wave

cenas.camera: medium shot, the two Rivals in front of the huge finished wall that towers over them
cenas.acao: the two Rivals look up at the tall finished wall, their smiles drop, they slump their shoulders embarrassed; the Fox beside them looks up, gives up and walks away
cenas.audio: a sad cartoon trombone wah-wah, crickets

cenas.camera: medium close shot of the Hero facing the camera, the finished wall behind
cenas.acao: the Hero smiles at the camera, points at the viewer and gives a big thumbs up

cenas.camera: slow dolly over the excavation: first the hands of an archaeologist gently brushing dust off ancient stones and pottery shards, then the big stone tower ruin
cenas.acao: an archaeologist (only her hands and khaki sleeves visible, no face) brushes dust off old stones and lifts a pottery shard into the sunlight
cenas.audio: brush strokes on stone, light wind, distant city

cenas.camera: medium shot of two adult archaeologists in khaki and sun hats seen from the side, debating over a pottery shard
cenas.acao: one archaeologist holds a pottery shard with a magnifying glass and nods, the other crosses his arms and shakes his head in doubt, both puzzled
cenas.audio: light wind, murmured discussion without words

cenas.camera: medium shot of the Hero facing the camera on top of the wall
cenas.acao: the Hero holds a hammer in one hand and a round shield in the other, looks at one then the other, then shrugs at the camera with a playful questioning smile
